title: FMXJ
description: JSON Schema for FME Transformer FMXJ files

fmxjVersion.description: FMXJ specification version, expressed as the FME build number tied to the last change in the FMXJ format. It signals compatibility to tools such as Transformer Designer and packagers; it is not the transformer's own version number.

info.description: Header metadata shared across all versions of the transformer. Use it for discovery, categorization, deprecation, and internal authoring notes.

versions.description: Transformer version definitions ordered newest first. The first element is the version exposed for new instances, while older entries preserve upgrade and backward-compatibility behavior.

choiceSettings.description: Settings that define where selectable values come from and how they are presented. Choice sets may be static, schema-driven, reader-driven, or backed by scripted services.

choiceSet.description: Source of the available choices. It can be a user-defined list or a built-in FMXJ choice source such as attributes, coordinate systems, readers, or web connections.

choices.description: Explicit choice list used primarily with userDefined, and sometimes to customize display/value mappings for other choice-based controls. Each item pairs a backend value with optional display text.

display.description: User-facing label shown in the UI for this choice. If omitted, the raw value is displayed.

value.description: Stored parameter value for this choice. This is what execution instructions and saved workspaces receive.

sort.description: Accepted values: `noSort` preserves the supplied or provider order; `naturalSort` sorts choices in human-readable order. Default: `naturalSort` for `userDefined`; built-in choice sets may override this.

listSupport.description: Level of list-attribute support when the choice set exposes attribute names. This controls whether list elements, list names, or no list content are offered.

showSearch.description: Whether the selection UI should include a search field. This is mainly used by scripted or large choice browsers.

attributeListSettings.description: Extra settings for reader-driven attribute-list extraction, such as which list elements provide display and value text.

configuration.description: Named configuration values passed into dynamic or reader-backed choice sources. Each entry supplies constants or parameter references consumed by the choice provider.

dataset.description: Dataset path, URL, or parameter reference used by reader-backed choice sets. It tells the provider where to read candidate values from.

destinationCoordSys.description: Destination coordinate system used when listing geometry transformations. It is only meaningful for engines that need both source and destination systems.

engine.description: Transformation engine to use when enumerating geometry transformations. The accepted values are defined by the specific choice set.

exclude.description: Subset of generated values to remove from the choice list. Do not combine it with include.

excludedServices.description: Web service names to omit when listing web connections.

format.description: Reader format name, or a parameter reference to it, for choice sets that inspect external datasets.

include.description: Subset of generated values to keep. Use it to whitelist relevant choices instead of exposing the full underlying set.

itemIcon.description: Icon path shown beside items in scripted selection browsers. An empty string explicitly suppresses icons.

module.description: Python module that supplies scripted selection values. If omitted, FMXJ may derive it from serviceName.

readCallToUse.description: Reader method to call when fetching choices from an external dataset, such as reading schema only versus reading values.

reprojectionEngine.description: Coordinate-system engine used when listing available coordinate system choices.

selection.description: Allowed item kinds in scripted selection browsers, such as objects or containers. These flags shape what the user can choose from the service.

serviceName.description: Name of the external service or scripted selection service to browse. It also informs derived defaults such as URL host or module name.

services.description: Web service names to include when listing web connections. If empty, all available services are eligible.

sourceCoordSys.description: Source coordinate system used when listing geometry transformations.

sourcePorts.description: Input ports whose schema should be inspected when populating attribute or geometry-based choices. An empty array means all input ports.

type.description: Auxiliary type selector used by certain specialized choice sets. Its exact meaning depends on the chosen choiceSet.

valuesToUse.description: Reader-backed value category to extract, such as feature types, attribute names, attribute-list values, or SDE versions.

allowReadCoordSysFromFeature.description: Whether to include a special Read From Feature option when offering coordinate system choices.

includeDestinationFormatAttrs.description: Include destination-format attributes in an attribute-name choice list.

includeDestinationUserAttrs.description: Include destination user attributes in an attribute-name choice list.

includeSourceFormatAttrs.description: Include source-format attributes in an attribute-name choice list.

includeSourceUserAttrs.description: Include source user attributes in an attribute-name choice list.

includeUnexposedAttrs.description: Include unexposed upstream attributes, such as cached reader schema fields, when building attribute-name choices.

showIcon.description: Whether each generated choice should display an icon when the underlying choice set supports one.

excludeIncoming.description: Exclude attributes or geometry arriving from input ports when building the choice list, leaving only other supported sources.

conditionalVisibility.description: Visibility or enabled-state control expressed either as one of FMXJ's visibility tokens or as a dynamic condition object that resolves to a string or boolean-like state.

conditionalSetValue.description: Dynamic property used by setValue. Clauses are evaluated in order, and the first true condition supplies the value to assign.

if.description: Ordered set of condition clauses for dynamically setting a parameter value. The first clause whose condition evaluates true supplies the replacement value.

value.description: Literal string to assign when the clause matches.

parameter.description: Parameter whose current value should be copied instead of using a literal.

evaluateOnLoad.description: Whether the setValue rule should run when the form first loads, even before dependent values change.

override.description: Whether the rule may replace a user-provided value instead of leaving it intact.

then.description: Value or value-control object to apply when the clause matches.

conditionalValue.description: Generic dynamic property object used when a string or boolean may depend on other parameters.

default.description: Fallback value used when no clause matches or the condition cannot be evaluated at design time.

if.description: Ordered condition clauses. The first true clause wins and supplies the resulting value.

then.description: Resulting value to apply when this clause matches.

condition.description: General-purpose conditional object used wherever FMXJ allows a result to depend on parameter state. It follows the same ordered if-then-default model as other dynamic properties.

default.description: Fallback result used when no clause matches or an input value is unknown.

if.description: Ordered condition clauses. The first true clause wins and supplies the resulting value.

then.description: Resulting value to apply when this clause matches.

conditionExpression.description: Logical condition expression built from a leaf comparison or a boolean operator over other expressions.

conditionLeaf.description: Single comparison or state-check condition applied to one parameter.

$equals.description: True when the target parameter's current value exactly matches the specified string. If the value is runtime-only or otherwise unknown, evaluation can fall back to the parent default.

parameter.description: Name of the parameter whose value should be compared.

value.description: Exact string value that the parameter must match.

$isEnabled.description: True when the named parameter currently exists and is enabled in the form.

parameter.description: Name of the parameter whose enabled state should be checked.

$matchesRegex.description: True when the target parameter's current value matches the supplied PCRE regular expression.

parameter.description: Name of the parameter whose value should be matched.

regex.description: Regular expression that the parameter value must satisfy.

$isRuntimeValue.description: True when the target parameter currently resolves to a runtime-only value, such as a published parameter or expression.

parameter.description: Name of the parameter whose runtime-value state should be checked.

$lessThan.description: True when the target parameter's current value is less than the supplied value. Numeric comparison is used when both sides are numeric; otherwise FMXJ compares lexicographically.

parameter.description: Name of the parameter whose value should be compared.

value.description: Threshold value that the parameter must be less than.

$greaterThan.description: True when the target parameter's current value is greater than the supplied value. Numeric comparison is used when both sides are numeric; otherwise FMXJ compares lexicographically.

parameter.description: Name of the parameter whose value should be compared.

value.description: Threshold value that the parameter must be greater than.

conditionAnd.description: Logical AND over child condition expressions.

$allOf.description: All child condition expressions that must evaluate true.

conditionOr.description: Logical OR over child condition expressions.

$anyOf.description: Alternative condition expressions where any true branch is enough.

conditionNot.description: Logical negation of a child condition expression.

$not.description: Condition expression whose result is inverted.

form.description: Container for the parameters that make up a transformer dialog or nested parameter set. The order of the parameter array controls layout and interaction flow.

parameters.description: Top-level parameters shown in the form. These definitions drive the UI layout, validation, and runtime values passed into execution.

info.description: Transformer header metadata that applies across all published versions. These fields control how the transformer is named, categorized, discovered, and maintained.

name.description: Primary transformer name shown in Workbench and used as its canonical identifier. This name is required even if aliases are provided.

decorationName.description: Base name of the SVG decoration icon shown on the transformer banner. The asset is resolved from the active Workbench theme.

categories.description: High-level categories used to group the transformer in browsing and search. Choose categories that describe the transformer's main functional area rather than every possible use case.

aliases.description: Older or alternate names that should still resolve to this transformer. This is mainly for rename compatibility and search discoverability.

keywords.description: Extra search terms that help users find the transformer when the name and aliases are not enough. Use task-oriented or domain terms that users are likely to query.

deprecated.description: Marks the transformer as unavailable for creating new instances. Existing workspaces can still load and run it.

comments.description: Internal developer notes about design, maintenance, or future work. These comments are not end-user help text.

parameter.description: Definition of a single FMXJ parameter or parameter container. The parameter type determines which additional properties are meaningful and how the UI stores the resulting value.

name.description: Internal parameter name used in saved workspaces, dynamic conditions, and execution-template substitution. It must be unique within the transformer version.

type.description: UI control type for the parameter, such as text, dropdown, group, or table. The type determines which other schema properties are meaningful.

prompt.description: User-facing label or text shown for the parameter. It is required whenever the parameter is configured to show a prompt.

valueType.description: Accepted values: `string` stores the raw value directly; `stringEncoded` stores one escaped FMEParsableText value; `stringEncodedParts` stores escaped parts intended to be recombined by the consumer.

defaultValue.description: Default literal value shown when the user has not supplied one. The allowed JSON type depends on the parameter kind.

required.description: Whether the dialog treats an empty value as invalid and highlights it accordingly.

visibility.description: Visibility and enabled-state control for the parameter. It may be a fixed FMXJ visibility token or a dynamic condition object.

setValue.description: Dynamic rule that sets or overrides the parameter value in response to other parameter state.

deprecatedFlags.description: Legacy UI behavior flags retained for compatibility with older parameter definitions. Avoid adding new uses unless a matching Workbench behavior requires them.

supportedValueTypes.description: Alternate value mechanisms the UI should allow in addition to literal values, such as expressions or global parameters. Use none to disable everything except literals.

showPrompt.description: Whether the prompt label should be shown. When true, prompt must be present and non-empty.

expressionSettings.description: Additional settings that tailor expression authoring or validation when expression values are allowed.

excludeFromDialogValidation.description: Skips standard dialog-time validation for this parameter. Use it when validation must be deferred or handled elsewhere.

parameters.description: Child parameters contained inside a group parameter. Their order defines the group's layout and dialog flow.

collapse.description: Whether a collapsible or checkable group starts collapsed.

style.description: Visual behavior for group parameters, such as plain, collapsible, checkable, or borderless. It determines whether the group has its own value and chrome.

gridColumns.description: Number of columns used to lay out child parameters within a group.

predefinedSet.description: Name of a built-in group preset such as reader options, writer options, XML flatten options, or authentication options. These presets inject standardized parameter bundles.

radioParameter.description: Turns a group into a radio-select container where one child parameter is active at a time. The group's own value becomes the selected child.

delimiter.description: Legacy delimiter used when serializing multi-valued controls or grouped values into a string. New definitions usually rely on the parameter type's native encoding instead.

expand.description: Dynamic control for whether a group is expanded in the UI. Use it when a group's open or closed state depends on other parameter values.

choiceSettings.description: Choice-source configuration for controls that render selectable values. Depending on the parameter type, this may be required, optional, or forbidden.

allowOrdering.description: Whether a listbox selection can be reordered by the user.

singleSelection.description: Whether the control allows only one selected item at a time. It is used by listbox and tree-style selectors.

showParentsAsLeaves.description: Whether parent nodes in a tree may be selected as values, not just expanded to reveal children.

nodesToExpand.description: Tree node names that should open by default when the selector is shown.

nodeDelimiter.description: Delimiter used inside choice values to separate tree hierarchy levels.

editor.description: Editor mode for text parameters, controlling syntax highlighting and specialized validation or helper dialogs.

showArithmeticEditor.description: Adds the arithmetic editor to the parameter's context menu when supported.

showInlineEditor.description: Shows the full editor widget directly in the dialog instead of launching it only from a button.

showEditButton.description: Shows a button that opens the parameter in a dedicated editor dialog.

trimWhitespace.description: Whether leading and trailing whitespace should be removed from the saved text value.

regexSettings.description: Options specific to regex editors, such as test-string and matching behavior.

sqlSettings.description: Options specific to SQL editors, such as mode and dataset or connection context.

xQuerySettings.description: Options specific to XQuery editors, such as which helper function groups to expose.

webSocketSettings.description: Options specific to WebSocket editors, such as open and send helper actions.

urlSettings.description: Options specific to URL editors, such as allowed schemes.

readOnly.description: Prevents direct editing in the UI while still showing the current value.

minimum.description: Lowest allowed numeric value, subject to minimumExclusive.

maximum.description: Highest allowed numeric value, subject to maximumExclusive.

multipleOf.description: Numeric step size or precision constraint. For example, 0.01 limits values to two decimal places.

minimumExclusive.description: Whether the minimum bound is strict rather than inclusive.

maximumExclusive.description: Whether the maximum bound is strict rather than inclusive.

showSlider.description: Whether number parameters should also render a slider bounded by the configured range.

sliderTickIncrement.description: Distance between slider tick marks. A value of 0 lets the UI calculate a suitable increment.

precision.description: Number of decimal places to display for numeric input.

checkedValue.description: Stored value when a checkbox is checked.

uncheckedValue.description: Stored value when a checkbox is unchecked.

textAlignRight.description: Legacy checkbox layout flag that moves the label to the right-hand side.

accessMode.description: Accepted values: `read` treats the path as an input location; `write` treats it as an output location; `readwrite` represents both in legacy docs, though authored `file` parameters validated here are narrowed later to `read` or `write`.

allowURL.description: Allows the file parameter to accept a URL instead of a local filesystem path.

filters.description: File browser filters that limit which filenames or extensions appear selectable.

itemsToSelect.description: Accepted values: `files` allows regular files; `folders` allows directories; `filegeodb` allows file geodatabases; `esriLayers` allows ESRI layer selections.

selectMultiple.description: Whether the file browser allows multiple selections, producing a list-valued result instead of a single path.

validateExistence.description: Whether the selected file or folder must already exist.

columns.description: Column definitions for a table parameter. Each column is itself a parameter schema applied per row.

allowAdd.description: Whether the table UI shows controls for adding and removing rows.

allowRowMove.description: Whether the table UI shows controls for reordering rows.

columnDelimiter.description: Legacy delimiter used when serializing table columns into a string form.

alternativeColumnDelimiter.description: Fallback legacy column delimiter accepted in addition to columnDelimiter.

rowDelimiter.description: Legacy delimiter used when serializing table rows into a string form.

showHeadings.description: Whether the table displays column headers.

rowsToStart.description: Number of empty rows to populate when the dialog first opens.

columnToStretch.description: Zero-based display column that should expand horizontally with the dialog.

columnDisplayOrder.description: Zero-based display order for table columns. Other index-based table settings are interpreted in this order.

columnsToHide.description: Zero-based display columns that should remain hidden in the table UI.

explicitSupportedValues.description: Whether table columns define their own supportedValueTypes instead of inheriting the table's setting.

importSettings.description: Configuration for the table's optional Import action, including how external fields map into columns.

inlineTable.description: Whether the table is shown directly in the dialog rather than collapsed to a launcher field.

mimeType.description: Clipboard MIME type name used to enable row copy and paste between compatible tables. If omitted, the parameter name acts as the type.

rowKeyword.description: Backward-compatibility mapping-file keyword for table row serialization. The docs explicitly mark it as do not use.

iconFolder.description: Folder containing icon files for icon parameters. Paths are resolved relative to the package or FME installation context.

geometryEncoding.description: String encoding used when storing geometry parameter values, such as FME XML or GeoJSON.

includeEffects.description: Whether the font picker lets users configure underline or strikeout effects.

includeSize.description: Whether the font picker lets users choose a font size.

includeStyle.description: Whether the font picker lets users choose style variations such as bold or italic.

supportedFonts.description: Subset of fonts that should appear in the font picker. An empty list means all available fonts.

componentValueType.description: How individual color components are encoded in the saved value, such as integers, floats, or hex pairs.

valueFormat.description: Optional format string applied to the raw color value, with %1 replaced by the encoded components.

format.description: Type-specific format selector. For example, datetime parameters use it to distinguish date from datetime storage.

autoNums.description: Internal-only zero-based table columns that auto-increment numeric defaults and remain read-only.

collapseFromColumn.description: Zero-based display column where trailing empty table columns start collapsing by default.

loadSet.description: Dynamic logic that selects which parameterSet is currently loaded for a multi parameter.

predefinedSetSettings.description: Additional settings for a built-in group preset such as reader, writer, or authentication options.

connectionInfoOnly.description: Limit a predefined reader or writer options group to connection-related controls.

disableCoordSys.description: Hide or disable coordinate-system options in predefined reader or writer settings.

supportPublishedParams.description: Allow published-parameter style values inside the predefined settings group.

hideGroupBox.description: Suppress the outer group-box chrome around predefined settings.

hideSpatialSettings.description: Hide spatial settings from predefined reader or writer options.

multipleDatasets.description: Allow predefined reader or writer options to work with multiple datasets rather than a single one.

supportAttributes.description: Expose attribute-related options inside the predefined settings group.

useSessionDefaults.description: Initialize predefined settings from current session defaults rather than only hard-coded defaults.

supportFormats.description: Restrict predefined reader or writer options to the listed format names.

parametersToHide.description: Names of predefined child parameters that should be suppressed from the rendered group.

groupTitle.description: Custom title shown on an authentication options group.

radioValue.description: Custom stored value for a radio-style selection when the visible choice label should map to a different backend value.

inline.description: Whether list or tree selection UI is rendered directly in the dialog instead of in a secondary chooser.

addAsAttribute.description: Attribute name to populate from this parameter's value when the surrounding tool supports treating the parameter as an output attribute.

runnable.description: Internal-only marker indicating that the parameter value is intended to be valid executable script.

showConfirm.description: Whether password parameters show a second confirmation field and require both entries to match.

showDecimalPrecision.description: Whether the UI should expose or emphasize decimal-precision controls for the parameter.

numCols.description: Number of columns used to lay out radio choices.

bounds.description: Map viewport bounds used by geometry pickers for initial framing or navigation.

top.description: Top latitude or Y boundary of the initial geometry view.

bottom.description: Bottom latitude or Y boundary of the initial geometry view.

left.description: Left longitude or X boundary of the initial geometry view.

right.description: Right longitude or X boundary of the initial geometry view.

includeWebBrowser.description: Adds a web-based browser option to file selection dialogs when supported.

separate.description: Legacy file-parameter option related to separating destination path components. It is kept for backward compatibility.

colorSpace.description: Accepted values: `rgb` stores red, green, and blue components; `hsv` stores hue, saturation, and value; `cmyk` stores cyan, magenta, yellow, and black; `hsl` stores hue, saturation, and lightness. Default: `rgb`.

alpha.description: Whether the color value includes an alpha or transparency component.

scrollTo.description: Accepted values: `noScroll` opens at the top; `firstExpanded` scrolls to the first expanded node; `lastExpanded` scrolls to the last expanded node. Default: `lastExpanded`.

defaultFilter.description: Initial filter text applied when a tree selector opens.

showSelectedItemGroup.description: Whether the tree selector shows a summary group of currently selected items.

textElideMode.description: Accepted values: `elideText` truncates long labels with an ellipsis; `showHorizontalScrollBar` keeps the full text and adds horizontal scrolling. Default: `elideText`.

maxDepth.description: Maximum selectable tree depth, where 0 means no limit.

defaultParameter.description: Parameter to surface as the inline representative of a group when it is used inside tables. Without it, only the launch button may be shown.

parameterSets.description: Alternative parameter-set definitions for a multi parameter. Each set defines a form that can be loaded based on loadSet logic.

showPrompt.description: Whether the prompt label should be shown. When true, prompt must be present and non-empty.

prompt.description: User-facing label or text shown for the parameter. It is required whenever the parameter is configured to show a prompt.

type.description: Accepted values: `dropdown`, `listbox`, `radio`, and `tree` are the parameter types that require `choiceSettings` in this validation branch.
UI control type for the parameter, such as text, dropdown, group, or table. The type determines which other schema properties are meaningful.

columns.description: Column definitions for a table parameter. Each column is itself a parameter schema applied per row.

accessMode.description: Accepted values: `read` treats the path as an input location; `write` treats it as an output location.

type.description: UI control type for the parameter, such as text, dropdown, group, or table. The type determines which other schema properties are meaningful.

parameterSet.description: One selectable form variant inside a multi parameter. Controllers or dynamic loadSet logic choose which set is currently active.

set.description: Identifier for this parameter set. It is used by multi-parameter controllers and load-set logic to choose which form to show.

defaultParameter.description: Parameter to surface as the inline representative of this set when it is displayed inside a table cell.

form.description: Form definition for this parameter set.

title.description: Optional dialog title for this parameter set when it is displayed in a sub-dialog.

parameterReference.description: Reference to another parameter whose current value should be substituted at runtime. This is used in places where FMXJ accepts either a literal string or a parameter-driven value.

parameter.description: Name of another parameter whose runtime value should be substituted here instead of a literal string.

stringOrParameterReference.description: Value that may be provided literally or by referencing another parameter.

inputPortNames.description: List of input port names targeted by a preservation clause. An empty array means all input ports.

preservesAttributesClause.description: Rule describing which incoming attributes survive to an output port, optionally filtered or renamed with a prefix.

inputPorts.description: Input ports whose attributes this clause applies to. Omit or use an empty array to make the rule apply to all inputs.

condition.description: Condition that decides when this preservation rule applies. If omitted, the clause always applies.

prefix.description: Prefix to prepend to preserved attribute names as they are advertised on the output port. It may be a constant string or parameter-expanded text.

attributeNames.description: Comma-delimited attribute names to preserve, or a parameter reference resolving to that list. An empty string means preserve all attributes from the selected inputs.

preservesGeometryClause.description: Rule describing which incoming geometry survives to an output port.

inputPorts.description: Input ports whose geometry this clause applies to. Omit or use an empty array to make the rule apply to all inputs.

condition.description: Condition that decides when this geometry-preservation rule applies. If omitted, the clause always applies.

geometryClause.description: Rule describing geometry names or types that may be added to or removed from an output port.

name.description: Name of the geometry affected by the clause. This may be literal or derived from another parameter.

types.description: Geometry type names affected by this clause, such as fme_point or fme_polygon. If omitted, the clause applies regardless of geometry type.

condition.description: Condition controlling when the geometry change applies. If omitted, the clause always applies.

inputPort.description: Definition of a transformer input port, including its execution-template name and any UI-facing label or visibility rules.

name.description: Port name used in execution instructions and workspace connections. An empty name is allowed for the default unlabeled input.

displayName.description: User-facing label shown for the port. If omitted, Workbench derives a label from templateName or name.

description.description: Tooltip text shown when users hover over the port.

optional.description: Whether the workspace can run with nothing connected to this input. Optional ports are allowed to remain unlinked.

templateName.description: Execution-template token name used to insert this port's input lines. Use it when the template tag should differ from the visible port name.

visible.description: Conditional visibility for the port in the UI. The underlying execution behavior can still exist even when the port is hidden.

outputAttribute.description: Metadata describing an attribute that an output port may add. This is a user-facing hint, not a hard runtime contract.

name.description: Name of the output attribute the transformer may add. This may be literal or supplied by another parameter.

type.description: Declared FME attribute type for the added attribute. This is metadata shown to users rather than a runtime contract.

width.description: Width or length metadata required for fixed-width string, binary, and numeric attribute types.

decimal.description: Decimal precision metadata for number output attributes.

condition.description: Condition controlling when this attribute should be advertised as added on the output port.

type.description: Accepted values: `char` and `varchar` are string types that require `width`; `binary` and `varbinary` are binary types that require `width`; `number` is a numeric type that requires both `width` and `decimal` in this validation branch.
Declared FME attribute type for the added attribute. This is metadata shown to users rather than a runtime contract.

outputPort.description: Definition of a transformer output port, including its UI label and the attributes or geometry it preserves, adds, or removes.

name.description: Output port name used in the workspace and execution template. An empty string collapses the port into the banner, and <REJECTED> has special rejected-port behavior in the UI.

displayName.description: User-facing label for the output port. If omitted, Workbench derives it from the port name.

description.description: Tooltip text shown when users hover over the output port.

visible.description: Conditional visibility for the port in the UI. Hidden ports can still exist as part of the version definition.

attributesAdded.description: Output attributes this port may add to emitted features. This list is user guidance about the transformer's effects rather than a hard runtime guarantee.

geometryAdded.description: Geometry names or types that this port may add to emitted features.

geometryRemoved.description: Geometry names or types that this port may remove from emitted features.

preservesAttributes.description: Rules describing which incoming attributes survive to this output and how they may be prefixed or filtered. If the property is absent, all input attributes are treated as preserved.

preservesGeometry.description: Rules describing which incoming geometry survives to this output. If the property is absent, geometry from all inputs is treated as preserved.

version.description: One published version of a transformer definition. Each version carries its own UI, execution instructions, ports, upgrade metadata, and compatibility markers.
Transformer definition version, unique within this transformer. The latest or highest version is used for new instances, while older versions remain for upgrade compatibility.

description.description: Tooltip text shown when users hover over the transformer. Keep it short and user-focused.

changeLog.description: Version-to-version change summary shown in help and upgrade contexts. The first version normally uses Initial Version, and the array must contain at least one entry.

comments.description: Internal notes specific to this transformer version. Use them for maintainer context that should not appear in the UI.

form.description: Parameter form for this version of the transformer. It defines the editable UI and the parameter tree used at runtime.

executionTemplate.description: Mapping-file template lines emitted for this version's execution instructions. These strings connect parameters and ports to the FME factories and functions that actually run.

inputPorts.description: Input port definitions for this version. Each port controls how features can enter the transformer and how the UI labels and conditions that entry.

outputPorts.description: Output port definitions for this version. These ports describe visible exits plus the attribute and geometry behavior advertised to users.

featureHolding.description: Accepted values: `none` processes features as they arrive; `grouped` holds features by group before completing output; `all` holds all input features before completing output. Default: `none`.

dataProcessingType.description: Classification used for browsing and filtering transformers as sources, destinations, both, or neither. FMXJ also allows this value to be conditional so the classification can depend on parameter state.

pythonCompatability.description: Minimum Python compatibility marker for the transformer, typically encoded as a major or minor string such as 36. The schema only enforces that it is a string.

arcgisCompatability.description: Accepted values: `auto` lets FME decide compatibility automatically; `arcmap` marks the transformer as ArcMap-oriented; `arcpro` marks it as ArcGIS Pro-oriented. Default: `auto`.

namedConditions.description: Reusable named dynamic conditions that other conditional properties can reference. This reduces duplication when the same logic appears on multiple parameters or ports.

internalOnly.description: FME-internal metadata used by shipped transformers for special canvas, port, or legacy behaviors. These settings are not general authoring guidance for package transformers.

upgradeProperties.description: Instructions for upgrading saved workspaces from this version to a newer one. Use these mappings when parameters or ports are renamed, replaced, or migrated.

upgradeWarning.description: Custom warning shown when upgrading from this version. Defining it usually means the transformer should be excluded from bulk upgrade flows.

internalOnly.description: Internal-only metadata consumed by shipped FME transformers and Workbench internals. Most package authors should not need these fields.

canvasProperties.description: Canvas-only directives that adjust navbar visibility, context menu actions, banner imagery, or inspection behaviors. Each entry is a semicolon-delimited instruction string interpreted by Workbench internals.

dynamicInputPorts.description: Special input tag names used by the UI to create or manage dynamic ports without writing those tags into the mapping file. Values are FMEParsableText-encoded because the display names may contain spaces.

multiProcess.description: Legacy group-parameter hook used by older multiprocess behavior. It is retained for backward compatibility rather than new authoring.

nukersRequired.description: Forces an explicit OUTPUT clause so cleanup logic always runs. This is only needed for certain factory patterns that depend on output-side behavior.

listActions.description: Legacy list-handling directives describing how list attributes should be built, exploded, removed, or kept across inputs and outputs. These strings are interpreted by older transformer internals.

parameterLookup.description: Legacy lookup metadata for choice-list parameters that need extra display-to-value mappings or workspace upgrade compatibility. Keys are current parameter names and values describe related lookup strings.

upgradeProperties.description: Upgrade mapping rules used when this transformer version evolves into a newer one. These rules preserve saved workspace intent across renamed or replaced components.

replacedBy.description: Declares that this transformer version has been superseded by another transformer. This supports upgrade guidance for deprecated transformers.

transformerName.description: Canonical name of the replacement transformer.

version.description: Specific replacement version to target. If omitted, upgrade tools can fall back to the replacement transformer's latest version.

portMapping.description: How old port names map to port names in the next version. Use it when an upgrade needs to reconnect saved workspace links.

portName.description: Name of the port in this version that should be upgraded.

newName.description: Name of the port in the newer version that receives existing connections.

direction.description: Accepted values: `in` means the mapped port is an input; `out` means the mapped port is an output.

parameterMapping.description: How parameter values from this version should populate parameters in the next version. Use it for renamed parameters, changed defaults, or transformed values.

newName.description: Parameter name in the newer version that should receive the migrated value.

parameter.description: Name of the old parameter whose value should be copied into newName.

newValue.description: Value to assign to the newer parameter, either as a literal string or by copying another parameter's value.

valueMappings.description: Special-case conversions for legacy value states such as unused, empty, or non-empty. This lets upgrade logic preserve intent when the newer parameter uses a different representation.

unusedValue.description: Replacement value to use when the older parameter was in an unused state.

nonEmptyValue.description: Replacement value to use when the older parameter had any non-empty value.

emptyValue.description: Replacement value to use when the older parameter was present but empty.
